segments.text: Ok so this is the Headless Threads page for Google ADK, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the thread list uses an agent called my agent,
but the chat here runs on the default agent, so they don't match.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
The select prop on the thread sidebar wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. The chat replies fine, and it should list the thread so I can open it, but the thread list stays empty.
So basically, the two snippets use different agents and the sidebar never opens a thread, so you can't switch threads at all.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
